description:
The physical facts about a dwelling in one call: bedrooms, bathrooms,
parking spaces, dwelling type (house, unit, townhouse and so on) and land
area in square metres.

Priced as the sum of the five individual calls. Ask for a single field
instead if that is all you need.

**Price: 23¢ per call.**
